description: Book a Royal Mail shipment via Click & Drop. Returns an orderIdentifier used to retrieve the label.

despatchDate.description: Planned despatch date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit if your account does not allow future-dated orders

notifyPhone.description: Mobile number for SMS delivery notifications

packageFormat.description: Package format. Determines which services are available and pricing

reference.description: Your internal order or job reference

safePlace.description: Safe place instructions e.g. "leave in porch"

sender.description: Sender address. Omit to use the address saved in your Click & Drop account

service.description: Royal Mail or Parcelforce service. Use a key from list_services, such as "first-class", "tracked-24", "tracked-48" or "special-delivery-1000", or a raw Service Register code such as OLP1 or TOLP24. Ask which service is wanted rather than guessing.

shippingCost.description: Shipping cost charged to recipient in GBP

subtotal.description: Order subtotal in GBP (used for customs/insurance)
